'''900 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. During that period of [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] explored parts of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], and settlers colonized previously unexplored regions of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Around 900 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the five families of the [[Quintad/Legends|Quintad]] oligarchy arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and began remaking it into a polluted [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]].

==Proem==
Located at the intersection of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]], and the [[Yankirk Route]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] enjoyed a certain level of importance from the [[Time/Legends|time]] the first colonists arrived on the world. For [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]], Eriadu was famous more for [[Eriaduan shellwork jewelry|shellwork jewelry]] than for its industrial power.<ref name="geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] narrowly escaped destruction as a conflict called the [[New Sith Wars]], which had been fought between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]], came to an end. The [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], a collection of reforms to restructure the Republic, was announced by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was reorganized,<ref name="atlas" /> and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was codified in Republic law as a branch of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==The galaxy in 900 BBY==
The year 900 BBY was also known as 2,753 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC),<ref name="YearTC" /> a peace agreement that brought an end to the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="atlas" /> 900 BBY was additionally the same as 100 after the Ruusan Reformation<ref name="YearRuu" /> and 865 before the [[Great ReSynchronization]] (BrS), a year-notation system established in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]].<ref name="YearGrS" /> The year was part of an era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], which began with the Ruusan Reformation one hundred years before.<ref name="tcswe-era">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> In that period of time, the Republic further explored the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and charted regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that were then considered [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], but which later became incorporated into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="atlas" />

Around 900 BBY, five families of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] ancestry, known as the [[Quintad/Legends|Quintad]] oligarchy, emigrated to Eriadu and began to remake the planet into a [[Factory world/Legends|manufacturing]] giant.<ref name="atlas" />

==Impact==
The Republic continued to expand, and the Great Peace of the Republic lasted for nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|nine hundred more years]]. [[Galactic economy|Economic forces]] began to shape the Republic, as companies established the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] from [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] acquired in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]].<ref name="nec" />

Under the leadership of the Quintad, Eriadu became an industrial powerhouse, the site of [[Eriadu Manufacturing|prestigious shipyards]] and the very model of an ambitious Rimworld.<ref name="geonosis" /> The planet became a polluted factory world, and due to the increase of [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] [[Acid/Legends|acidity]], the [[flow-mollusk]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] that produced the material for Eriadu's delicate shellwork jewelry, became extinct.<ref name="atlas" />

==Notable events==
*The Quintad, five families native to the planet Corulag, emigrated to Eriadu. {{Circa}}<ref name="atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 900 BBY was first mentioned in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[2004]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] supplement book ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', in which Eriadu received an entry.<ref name="geonosis" /> In [[2010]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' also mentioned the year in its description of Eriadu and slightly expanded the impact of the Quintad's industrial expansions.<ref name="atlas" />
